tasks.Implementation of Mitigations: Implementing security patches, updates, or other mitigations as part of the developed strategy.
tasks.Mitigation Strategy Development: Developing a strategy to mitigate risks associated with identified vulnerabilities.
tasks.Risk Assessment: Evaluating the risk level of identified vulnerabilities based on threat intelligence.
tasks.Threat Intelligence Gathering: Collecting relevant threat intelligence to understand potential cyber attack vectors.
tasks.Website Scanning: Scanning the website for known vulnerabilities and weaknesses.
